lede: One model carried the day across two feeds. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, listed on October 17, reached number five on Hacker News with 775 points and 617 comments, and at the same time sat atop Hugging Face's trending list with 1,053 likes, all before a single recorded download. Two Lemmy threads found their mirror in prediction markets: one on the new Tesla Roadster, where traders were 99.95 percent sure its 0 to 60 time will beat a second, and one on the next White House press secretary. On Wikipedia, a weapon quietly outdrew everyone, the GBU-43/B MOAB at 453,110 views.
